hits.title: What Is Speech Analytics? | Genesys
hits.snippet:
# Speech analytics

Speech analytics uses artificial intelligence (AI)-powered natural language understanding (NLU) to analyse voice recordings or live customer calls. The analysis can spot topics or key phrases; identify customer intent and sentiment; and help contact centres assess both agent performance and drivers of inbound interactions.

hits.title: Speech Analytics Call Centre Explained: Benefits and Features
hits.snippet:
By reviewing 100% of calls, supervisors get more accurate insights into agent performance. This leads to fairer evaluations, stronger coaching, and more consistent customer experiences.
 Speech analytics reduces operational waste and supports smarter decision-making. It highlights recurring problems, predicts call volume trends, and helps teams fix issues before they grow. [...] Speech analytics, sometimes called call centre voice analytics, uses AI to review large numbers of customer calls. The system turns spoken words into structured text. AI then analyses the text to find trends, sentiment, and important patterns. These insights help teams improve customer satisfaction, agent performance, and daily operations. The software also automates tasks like call scoring and after-call work. With speech analytics, teams can make clear, data-driven decisions instead of [...] Advanced speech analytics is a transformative technology for call centres, where words truly matter. AI can take in millions of data points and rapidly analyse them for flags, keywords, topics and trends, returning actionable data that call centre managers can use in myriad ways.

hits.snippet:
Contact centre data analysis involves collecting your customer data from as many sources as you have access to. These include digital channels, calls, chats and emails — and using analysis software to interpret all that gathered data, preferably in real time. This analysis is made much easier by having access to AI, which can analyse data faster and more efficiently. Key metrics like average handle time, first-call resolution, and positive and negative sentiment scores can reveal where your [...] With the Genesys Cloud platform, you can make sure you’re optimising for customer satisfaction with native AI-driven speech and text analytics, and you’ll be able to understand each interaction to improve service quality and agent performance alike.

### Gain fully comprehensive analytics

Genesys Cloud leverages AI to bring together customer interactions across all channels in one place. You can identify customer needs, agent behaviors and business trends with ease. [...] Speech analytics and voice (or acoustic) analytics work together to provide a holistic view of the content and quality of interactions. Speech analytics focuses on what is being said, the words and phrases that are used by both agent and customer. Acoustics analytics focuses on overtalk, silence and total talk time. Using both allows you to analyse what customers are asking for, how they’re getting help and how agents and customers feel.
